issue_request: FHIR-9201 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked to remove or disallow isSummary on the first/root element of type StructureDefinitions, clarify how ElementDefinition.isSummary controls _summary=true serialization, describe datatype summary behavior, link _summary search documentation to ElementDefinition.isSummary, and state that profiles cannot override isSummary.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 8685. Imported git commit 081c8ea90309b8ce3b8cfbc8d3163aa32a995add, titled "#9201 - note about summary searches", added the serializer/datatype note to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml and linked source/search.html's _summary=true entry to ElementDefinition.isSummary.
additional_context: Current source/elementdefinition.html marks isSummary as Not expected for type-definition and constraint-definition root elements and requires constraint-definition non-root values to match the base. Current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml includes _summary=true serializer behavior, datatype summary exceptions, and the FHIR-14272 link to ElementDefinition interpretation guidance. source/search.html links _summary=true to ElementDefinition.isSummary, and source/profiling.html says profiles cannot change isSummary. Later FHIR-14272, FHIR-33148, and FHIR-35855 refined the same wording, and relevant Zulip threads support the no-profile-override interpretation.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source change is needed. A source scan found 52 datatype root rows and zero non-empty Summary cells, and the active source surfaces already convey the requested semantics.
